page.overview:
Who is Kumiko Albertson?

Kumiko Albertson (アルバートソン久美子) (née Nakamura (中村)) is a Japanese mangaka and a manga fan from Osaka, Japan, and is the wife of Comic Book Guy. Initially, her father refused to let her see Comic Book Guy again, but after experiencing a dream in which he realized the true monster was himself, her father allowed her to marry Comic Book Guy. She makes her first appearance in The Simpsons: Tapped Out during the event before "Married to the Blob."

She was originally voiced by Tress MacNeille, but she is currently voiced by Jenny Yokobori.

Kumiko Albertson is Japanese with short black hair tied into a ponytail that she holds in place with a pink hairbow. She wears a pink hoodie with a bear on the front, a black miniskirt, white knee socks, black Mary Janes, and light pink lipstick.

Kumiko Albertson is a sweet, soft-spoken woman who comes from a culture and lifestyle of savadayor lifestyle, which favors obedience over originality. This is the reason why she loves Comic Book Guy so much because unlike herself, he always gets mad, complains, and speaks his mind about things, without fear of stepping out of line and being different. Kumiko is very cultural and regularly celebrates her roots in Japan. She likes anime, manga, cosplay, and praying to the Shinto religion.
